title: PrefReward: Learning User Preference Matrix for Personalized Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.21067v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable ability in generating personalized content by leveraging user histories and contextual cues. However, most existing personalization approaches rely on implicit representations within model parameters, making it difficult to interpret user-specific preferences or effectively handle long-context dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose PrefReward, a novel preference-aware generative framework that explicitly models user styles through a structured preference matrix and integrates it into the decoding process as a reward signal. PrefReward consists of two stages: (1) extracting a user-specific preference matrix that summarizes individual stylistic tendencies, and (2) using the matrix to guide generation via a KL-divergence-based reward function. Experiments on the LongLaMP dataset show that PrefReward outperforms retrieval-based baselines and context steering method

translated_title: PrefReward：学习用户偏好矩阵以实现个性化文本生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在利用用户历史和上下文线索生成个性化内容方面展现了卓越能力。然而，大多数现有的个性化方法依赖于模型参数中的隐式表示，这使得难以解释用户特定偏好或有效处理长上下文依赖关系。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PrefReward，一种新颖的偏好感知生成框架，它通过结构化偏好矩阵显式建模用户风格，并将其作为奖励信号集成到解码过程中。PrefReward包含两个阶段：（1）提取一个用户特定的偏好矩阵，用以总结个体的风格倾向；（2）利用该矩阵通过基于KL散度的奖励函数来引导生成。在LongLaMP数据集上的实验表明，PrefReward优于基于检索的基线方法和上下文引导方法。
tldr: 提出PrefReward框架，通过结构化用户偏好矩阵显式建模个体风格，并作为基于KL散度的奖励信号引导解码过程，实现更可解释且能处理长上下文的个性化文本生成。
